thread:
IncidentBot: PagerDuty alert fired: PD#83021 — high queue depth on inference-request-queue in us-west-2-prod. queue_depth > 10k for 4m, incoming RPS steady. Autoscaler not increasing replicas.

PagerDuty: PD#83021 acknowledged by Ashley (oncall). Escalation policy: eng-oncall -> runtime-team.

Ashley (oncall): saw the alert, I'm on it. tagging @Sam and @Maria. Is this the HPA or our custom scale-controller?

Sam (runtime): it's the custom scale-controller for inference-worker. Recent deploy to scale-controller yesterday. Could be a metrics scrape gap or controller loop stuck.

Maria (sre): pulling metrics now — prometheus shows scale_controller_reconcile_latency spiking, and the metric we base scaling on (queue_depth_per_shard) reports partial series missing for two nodes.

Kai (support): customers on hosted API are getting elevated 503s and higher retry rates. Got a ticket from a big customer on SDK timeouts. Need ETA for mitigation.

Ashley (oncall): mitigation plan: 1) try manual scale-up to relieve immediate queue backlog, 2) check scale-controller logs, 3) if controller unhealthy, fallback to manual autoscale policy. I'll do 1 now.

Ashley (oncall): running: ```kubectl -n prod scale deployment/inference-worker --replicas=60```

DeployBot: manual scale request accepted. Starting rolling scale, target replicas=60 for deployment/inference-worker-prod.

DeployBot: scale completed: 60 replicas reported by the API (duration ~70s).

Sam (runtime): nice. watching queue depth and worker CPU. queue_depth dropped from 12.3k -> 7.1k in 2m. token processing rate increased.

Maria (sre): scale-controller logs: ```ERROR scale_controller.go:212 reconcile loop timeout: last successful reconcile 00:08:23 ago``` — controller goroutine backlog, goroutine dump shows stuck in metrics aggregation for a particular exporter (metrics-exporter-17).

Sam (runtime): can we restart that exporter without impacting traffic? it's a read-only scraper.

Ashley (oncall): I can restart metrics-exporter-17. rolling restart now: ```kubectl -n prod rollout restart ds/metrics-exporter```

DeployBot: restarted metrics-exporter daemonset; pod metrics-exporter-17 restarted, status Running.

Maria (sre): controller reconcile latency normalizing. scale_controller_reconcile_latency 95pct dropped from 18s -> 1.4s. queue_depth continuing to fall to 2.2k. good.

Kai (support): passing update to CS: told them temporary elevated errors during 10:13-10:24 PST, mitigation in place, manual scale + exporter restart. Asking which customers were hit.

Ashley (oncall): PD note: manual scale to 60 replicas + restart metrics exporter resolved immediate backlog. Follow-ups: 1) investigate why exporter hung (connectivity/timeouts), 2) revert manual scale to HPA target after safe drain, 3) consider increasing scale-controller timeouts and maxReplicas. Assigning to Sam and Maria.

Sam (runtime): picking up follow-up: I'll run a post-mortem on yesterday's deploy->controller change. Also will open a PR to add healthcheck on metrics exporter and a circuit-breaker around metrics aggregation.

Maria (sre): I'll schedule a short blast radius test for scale-controller under synthetic load, and add an alert for reconcile_latency > 5s.

Ashley (oncall): handing off to Sam for post-incident follow-up. I'll keep the incident open in case queue climbs again. Marking PD as resolved/acknowledged for now.

PagerDuty: PD#83021 status: acknowledged -> resolved by Ashley (oncall).

Sam (runtime): final note — we should notify any customers with SLA impact. Kai, can you coordinate with CS for customer outreach?

Kai (support): on it. CC'ing CS lead, drafting timeline and mitigation steps.

Ashley (oncall): thanks team. I'll annotate this thread with timestamps and add the runbook steps we executed. End of live mitigation.
